concepts.gloss_en: darkened faces/countenance (Aramaic; aspect of concealment, evil traits, unillumined states)

reason_for_human: All 7 occurrences are the same fixed Aramaic phrase meaning 'darkened faces/countenance,' consistently used as the negative pole opposite אַנְפִּין נְהִירִין. The only variation is spelling חֲשׁוּכִין (plene) vs חֲשׁוֹכִין — plene/defective variation of the identical word, not a homograph. Contexts (concealment of knowledge, money-craving, evil traits, idolatry) are all applications of the one mystical concept.
